inbox.title: Guess Who's Counting
inbox.body: The studio would like an option on two further Guess Who's Counting pictures at your current fee of €3,757,045. €563,557 on signature, now. If the picture performs, the sequels are made and your fee is the fee in this letter while everybody else's goes up. If it does not, nothing happens and you keep the money. It lapses at wrap.

cta.label: Sign · €563,557 now
cta.reply: Signed. €563,557 clears the same afternoon. Two more, at this fee, if they want them.

cta.label: Refuse — keep the raise
cta.reply: You pass. If there is a sequel you will be negotiating it like everybody else — which is the point.

inbox.body: Thank you for coming in to read for Supporting on Platform 41. They have decided to go in a different direction. We will keep you in mind.

cta.label: Delete

inbox.subj: We'd love to have you on

good.reply: You kill it. "So likeable" trends with your name.

inbox.body: It is three paragraphs long and they have opinions about your face, your voice and your parents. It has been forwarded to you by someone who thought you should see it.

cta.label: Delete unread
cta.reply: Gone. It was never about you anyway.

press.head: First reviews: "Station 5" divides
press.body: The first reviews of "Station 5" are mixed: respectable in one paper, forgettable in the next. Mira Vale is "fine", which is the word critics use when they have nothing to say. The Friday crowd wants romance this month; a drama has a fight on its hands.
